init.title: Adlar Heatpump options
init.description:
Choose per installer parameter how it shows in Home Assistant:
- **Hidden**: no entity, and the value isn't read from the heat pump.
- **Read-only**: a sensor that shows the value.
- **Editable**: a number or dropdown that writes to the heat pump. Wrong values for protection, valve or frequency parameters can damage it.

Open a group, make your choices, and finish with **Save**.

data_description.set_all: Applies one choice to every parameter on this page; editable only where allowed.
data_description.reg_01fe: Heating medium in the system: water or antifreeze liquid. Values: 0 = water, 1 = antifreeze liquid.
data_description.reg_01ff: SG Ready (smart grid) input. Note: 0 enables, 1 disables. Values: 0 = enable, 1 = disable.
data_description.reg_0200: SG Ready: minutes before the unit turns off in the grid's ECO state. Range 30–999 min.
data_description.reg_0201: Dual temperature zones (radiators plus floor heating through a mixing valve): on at start, on demand, or off. Values: 0 = auto, 1 = manual, 2 = disable.
data_description.reg_0202: Dual zones: mixing valve adjustment cycle. Range 5–20 min.
data_description.reg_0203: Dual zones: time the mixing valve takes to go fully open or closed. Range 0–180 s.
data_description.reg_0204: Highest speed of the DC circulation pump. Range 50–99 %.
data_description.reg_0205: DC circulation pump speed while the temperature is reached. Range 20–99 %.
data_description.reg_0206: Floor heating test (screed drying) mode. Values: 0 = Enable, 1 = Disable.

data_description.set_all: Applies one choice to every parameter on this page; editable only where allowed.
data_description.reg_0800: Cycle of the electric pipe heating. Range 1–300 min.
data_description.reg_0801: Legionella sterilisation of the hot water tank: automatic every L13 days at L14, off, or started by hand. Values: 0 = auto, 1 = off, 2 = manual.
data_description.reg_0802: Days between two sterilisation runs. Range 5–30 days.
data_description.reg_0803: Time of day the sterilisation starts. Can't be made editable.
data_description.reg_0804: How long the tank is held at the sterilisation temperature. Range 0–50 min.
data_description.reg_0806: Water level control of the tank: off, high/low switch, or high/high/low switch. Values: 0 = Off, 1 = Hi/Lo switch, 2 = Hi/Hi/Lo switch.
data_description.reg_0807: Tank refill control: by level only, or by temperature and level. Values: 0 = level only, 1 = temp + level.
data_description.reg_0808: Water temperature that allows refilling. Range 0–99 °C.
data_description.reg_0809: Hysteresis of the refill water temperature. Range 0–20 °C.
data_description.reg_080a: What happens on low water: don't start, on without starting, or start. Values: 0 = no start, 1 = on but no start, 2 = start.
data_description.reg_080b: Hot water return (circulation) pump P_d: off, always on, in cycles (L25/L26), or by temperature (L23/L24). Values: 0 = disable, 1 = continuous return, 2 = cycle return, 3 = temperature diff return.
data_description.reg_080c: Hot water return: pipe temperature the circulation keeps. Range 20–65 °C.
data_description.reg_080d: Hot water return: circulation starts at L23 minus this. Range 1–15 °C.
data_description.reg_080e: Hot water return in cycles: interval between runs. Range 3–90 min.
data_description.reg_080f: Hot water return in cycles: run time. Range 1–30 min.
data_description.reg_0810: Use the own heating curve L28/L29 instead of the preset curves. Values: 0 = enable DIY curve, 1 = disable.
data_description.reg_0811: Own heating curve slope k: setpoint = k × (ambient + 15) + b. Negative. Range −50–0.
data_description.reg_0812: Own heating curve constant b in setpoint = k × (ambient + 15) + b. Range 30–80.
data_description.reg_0813: Internal energy accounting of the unit. Values: 0 = enable, 1 = disable.
data_description.reg_0814: Fixed water flow used for the energy accounting when no flow meter is fitted. Range 0–999 L/min.
data_description.reg_0815: Power of the hot water electric heater, for the energy accounting. Range 0–9999 W.
data_description.reg_0816: Power of electric pipe heater 1, for the energy accounting. Range 0–9999 W.
data_description.reg_0817: Power of electric pipe heater 2, for the energy accounting. Range 0–9999 W.
data_description.reg_0818: Power of the heating electric heater, for the energy accounting. Range 0–9999 W.
data_description.reg_0819: Power of the external water pump, for the energy accounting. Range 0–9999 W.
